p: said Solomon: After he had seen the glory of the Lord in the cloud.
covenant of the LORD: Meaning the two tables, in which is contained the effect of the covenant that God made with our fathers.
he stood before the altar of: On a scaffold that was made for that purpose, that he praying for the whole people might be heard by all, as in 1Ki 8:22.
spread forth his hands toward heaven: Both to give thanks for the great benefits of God bestowed on him, and also to pray for the perseverance and prosperity of his people.
eyes may be open upon this: That you may declare in effect that you have a continual care over this place.
neighbour: By retaining anything from him, or by denying that which he has left him to keep, or do him any wrong.
upon his own head: Meaning, to give him that which he has deserved.
heart thou knowest: He declares that the prayers of hypocrites cannot be heard, nor of any but of them who pray to God with a true faith and in true repentance.
pray in this house: He shows that before God there is no deception of person, but all people who fear him and work righteousness are accepted, Ac 10:35.
thou shalt send them: Meaning, that no one should enterprise any war, but at the Lord's command, that is, which is lawful by his word.
resting place: That is, into your temple.
salvation: Let them be preserved by your power, and made virtuous and holy.
thine anointed: Hear my prayer, I who am your anointed king.
